answers.answer: Stage double_quotation: first quote £780 for an expansion vessel; landlord asked for a second quote, Swift P&H visit 14 Oct per record. No repair until landlord decides; he keeps topping up pressure and reports loss of heating or gas smell. He is vulnerable, so I gave emergency advice.

answers.answer: Not a maintenance matter; pointed him to Tower Hamlets Council for missed collections, gave no date.

answers.question: Do you create any new tickets?
answers.answer: No. The boiler issue is already open and bins are council business.

assumptions: Replied by email as the tenant prefers email and no portal send channel exists; heating still works since he only repressurises weekly.

args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal. Boiler (R-4799): the first engineer visited and quoted for replacing a part (the expansion vessel). Because of the cost, your landlord asked for a second quote, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 October. Nothing is booked for the repair until the landlord decides after that. I'm sorry it feels slow. In the meantime, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water, or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We'll update you after the 14th. Bins: we don't handle collections, so please check the Tower Hamlets Council website or call them to report a missed collection. I can't give you a collection date myself.
